class.name: SteamNotificationSessionSpec
class.brief_description: Immutable full state for creating or updating an asynchronous game session.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates an immutable complete session spec. [param context] is a canonical unsigned decimal string used at creation. Supply a localized title and 1 to 16 distinct verified participants.

method.name: get_context
method.description: Return the backend context as an unsigned decimal string.

method.name: get_users
method.description: Return the full read-only participant state.

members.member: Backend context submitted when the session is created.
Title shown in the recipients' list of sessions.
Every verified participant and their desired state.
